module.name: roksbnkctl-orphan-reap
module.description: Delete the orphans reported by roksbnkctl-orphan-scan. DESTRUCTIVE. It acts only on that module's inventory, re-checks every name against the allowlist, and does nothing at all unless explicitly confirmed.

required.name: name_prefixes
required.label: Name prefixes to consider (comma-separated)
required.description: Re-checked against every name before it is touched, deliberately duplicating the scan's allowlist. The inventory arrives through Forge's module-output wiring, and a deleter should not take its target list entirely on trust from the layer that hands it over. Anything outside this list is refused and the run reports failure.

required.name: region
required.label: IBM Cloud region
required.description: Region the orphans are in. Inherits from the credential template. Must match the region the scan ran against.

required.name: confirm
required.label: Type DELETE to confirm
required.description: Must be exactly DELETE. Anything else — including blank — and the module exits 0 having deleted nothing. The guard is checked INSIDE the module rather than left to enabled:false, because bnk-forge#120 is the bug where Forge dispatched a module that was explicitly disabled, and neither cancel nor deleting the project stopped the container. A cluster-deleting module must not stake safety on the orchestration layer's opinion about whether to call it.

optional.name: ibmcloud_api_key
optional.label: IBM Cloud API key
optional.description: Filled from the project's credential template. Needs delete rights on clusters, VPCs, subnets, public gateways and Transit Gateways.

optional.name: orphan_cluster_names
optional.label: Clusters to delete
optional.description: Wired from the scan. Set by hand only if you are reaping a list you produced yourself and have checked.

optional.name: orphan_vpc_ids
optional.label: VPCs to delete
optional.description: Wired from the scan. Their subnets and public gateways go first, then the VPC.

optional.name: orphan_gateway_ids
optional.label: Transit Gateways to delete
optional.description: Wired from the scan. Connections are removed first.
